description: This Java class defines a JavaScript message mapper for the Eclipse Ditto project, using Rhino for executing scripts. It loads and executes JavaScript code for transforming external messages to Adaptable objects and vice versa, with configuration options for script size and execution settings.

classes.name: JavaScriptMessageMapperRhino
classes.description: A final class implementing a message mapper that uses Rhino JavaScript engine to execute mapping scripts for messages in Eclipse Ditto.

methods.name: doConfigure
methods.description: Configures the mapper with provided mapping configuration and options, loading necessary scripts and libraries, and initializing the scripting context.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Maps an ExternalMessage to a list of Adaptable objects using the incomingScript.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Maps an Adaptable object to a list of ExternalMessages using the outgoingScript.

methods.name: initLibraries
methods.description: Loads JavaScript libraries into the Rhino scripting context based on configuration.

methods.name: loadJavascriptLibrary
methods.description: Evaluates a JavaScript library script into the Rhino context from a given reader.
